title: Remote state and sharing data
intro: Two configurations live in `/home/coder/lab`: `network/` (applied, local state) and `app/` (empty). The S3 bucket `tfstate-lab` and the DynamoDB table `tf-locks` (partition key `LockID`) already exist. Open a terminal via **☰ → Terminal → New Terminal**.

tasks.text: Move the state of `network/` to the S3 bucket `tfstate-lab` under the key `network/terraform.tfstate`, with state locking in `tf-locks` and encryption enabled. Nothing may be recreated, and the local state must no longer be used.

Give `app/` the same backend with the key `app/terraform.tfstate`. Read the VPC ID from the network state with `terraform_remote_state` and create `aws_security_group.app` named `app-<current workspace>` in that VPC. Apply in the `default` workspace.
Create the workspace `staging` for `app/` and apply there as well, so `app-staging` exists next to `app-default`.
